notes.title: Kimbow Escape - Content Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Kimbow Escape - Content Update 1.1

News and Improvements:

Parallax Backgrounds
Backgrounds now have a parallax effect for more depth and immersion.

Improved Camera System

Visual effects during jumps, dashes and attacks.

Smooth transitions between lateral movements and automatic centering when stopping.

General Physics Improvements

More natural and responsive jumps and double jumps.

Improvements to movement and collisions.

Restructured Map

New layout of some areas for greater fluidity.

More immersive atmosphere and coherence with the narrative.

Visual Update

New cover art and visual adjustments in menus and HUD.
